description:
ChatGPT forgets between sessions and locks whatever it learns inside one tool. Komplyt Zero captures what matters from your conversations and turns it into a structured, searchable knowledge base that stays yours.

Ask a question, get an answer grounded in your own past work, decisions, and notes. No re-explaining context every time. No copy-pasting from a doc pile.

Free for one person. EU-hosted, private to you, never used to train any model. Your knowledge, portable across the tools you already use.
